fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: A ring around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Dropped Gate
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A bolt that deals 20 damage to the first enemy in its path and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Every Latch at Once
fusions.desc: After a 0.3-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds, and you finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Penned Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
